transcript.text: I want to build a proper career profile I can generate resumes from later. Interview me about my jobs, what I achieved and my skills, and save it somewhere I can keep updating.

I’m using the career-profiler skill to build your reusable career profile. This session is **guidance-only mode**: I can help assemble it in conversation, but I can’t save a persistent profile here.

Before the interview, choose an automation preference:

- **off** — Profile work and tailored resumes only when you ask. Recommended for now.
- **alert** — Watch sources you select and flag matching jobs; draft only when asked.
- **draft** — Watch those sources and draft a resume and cover letter for each match.
- **prepare** — Also prepare answers to screening questions for your review.

Every mode excludes submitting applications, logging in, solving CAPTCHAs, or sending your data to job boards. You can change the preference later.

Which setting do you want?

This initial choice is required by [career-profiler’s SKILL.md](sandbox:/tmp/cp-astra-msDrav/SKILL.md): “Until it prints `"state": "ok"`, the **only** thing to do is the setup playbook.” I can’t verify an existing preference in this session, so we need your choice before starting the interview.
